effect.minecraft.absorption.desc.en: Temporarily adds additional hearts that can't be regenerated.

effect.minecraft.bad_omen.desc.en: Causes an illager raid to start upon entering a village.

effect.minecraft.blindness.desc.en: Impairs vision and disables the ability to sprint and critical hit.

effect.minecraft.conduit_power.desc.en: Increases underwater visibility and mining speed, prevents drowning.

effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.desc.en: Prevents taking damage from fire sources, like fire and lava.

effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.des.en: Gives discounts on trades with villagers, and makes villagers throw gifts.

effect.minecraft.invisibility.desc.en: Grants invisibility, and reduces other mobs' detection range.

effect.minecraft.jump_boost.desc.en: Increases jump height and reduces fall damage.

effect.minecraft.luck.desc.en: Can increase chances of high-quality and more loot.

effect.minecraft.night_vision.desc.en: Lets the player see well in darkness and underwater.

effect.minecraft.poison.desc.en: Inflicts damage over time, but doesn't kill.

effect.minecraft.slow_falling.desc.en: Decreases falling speed and negates fall damage.

effect.minecraft.unluck.desc.en: Can reduce chances of high-quality and more loot.

effect.minecraft.water_breathing.desc.en: Prevents loosing air underwater and drowning.

effect.minecraft.wither.desc.en: Inflicts potentially deadly damage over time.
